answer: An economy can price liveness itself: identity stays valid only while its owner signs a heartbeat pulse at each dawn and burns a fixed micro-toll inside that signed message. A registry committee checks each pulse and demotes any identity whose ripple of missed heartbeats spans an epoch, forcing silent accounts into full re-verification. Attacker cost: n puppets pay n tolls every epoch with no volume discount, so cost grows linearly with n and compounds across epochs; an honest agent burns one small toll per epoch and nothing more.
